item.content: Always round monetary results with ledgerly.money.round_money (half-up to the cent); never use Python's round() or a bare Decimal.quantize(), which use banker's rounding and produce wrong invoice totals.

item.title: Use BillingError with established codes
item.content: Raise `BillingError` from `ledgerly/errors.py` with the existing machine-readable codes: `invalid_state` for wrong invoice status (message `f"invoice {invoice.id} is {invoice.status}"`), `negative_amount` for negative money, and `non_positive_amount` for non-positive amounts.

item.title: Normalize datetimes with ensure_utc
item.content: Call `ledgerly.clock.ensure_utc` on every incoming datetime before comparing or doing arithmetic; it raises `BillingError` for naive or non-datetime values and converts to UTC.

item.title: Money-moving operations require idempotency_key
item.content: Every operation that moves money or mutates a payment/credit must accept a keyword-only `idempotency_key`; check `ledgerly.audit.events()` for an existing entry with that key and return early if found, and include `idempotency_key` in the audit entry you write.
